signals.label: QQQ trend
signals.note: Green: QQQ closes above its 200-day AND the 200-day is higher than it was 20 sessions ago. Amber: within 3% either side of the 200-day, or above it while the 200-day is not rising. Red: more than 3% below the 200-day.

signals.label: Breadth
signals.note: Share of loop names trading above their own 200-day (pct200 > 0 in state/rsi-latest.json, index ETFs excluded). Green above 60%. Amber 40% to 60% inclusive. Red below 40%.

signals.label: Volatility
signals.note: Last VIX close. Green below 18. Amber 18 to 25 inclusive. Red above 25.

signals.label: Rates (10y)
signals.note: 10-year Treasury yield change over the last 20 sessions, in basis points. Red above +25bp. Amber +10bp to +25bp inclusive, or below -25bp. Green everywhere else.

signals.label: Fed path
signals.note: Nearest FOMC meeting priced off 30-day fed funds futures. Red if the hike probability is above 50%. Green if the cut probability is above 50%. Amber otherwise, and amber with "no futures quote" when the contracts do not price.

signals.label: Oil (WTI)
signals.note: WTI front-month change over the last 20 sessions. Red above +10%. Amber +5% to +10% inclusive, or below -10%. Green everywhere else.

signals.label: Credit (HYG)
signals.note: HYG (high yield credit) vs its own 200-day. Green above the 200-day. Amber within 1% of it. Red more than 1% below.

signals.label: Seasonality
signals.note: Static calendar. September is red in a US midterm year and amber otherwise. October is amber. November through April is green. May through August is amber.
